commands.cmd: npm run e2e (initial: missing FFmpeg; artifacts/e2e-first-attempt.log)

limitations: No model inference; deterministic recipe generation only.

Single in-memory recording session; no concurrency or durable persistence.
Dashboard controls drive the managed browser; no desktop browser extension.
macOS verified using read-only existing Chromium cache; clean-install Linux and Windows execution not verified.
